# Cicada

> Cicada is a music workstation in which a song is a readable text score. The
> same score renders to the same audio on every machine and in the browser.

An agent starts with `cicada agents`, which prints the quick start: write a
score, `cicada check --json`, `cicada render --json`, `cicada audition --json`,
then edit it with `cicada apply`. `cicada agents reference` prints the core
reference from the binary, and `make agent-front-door` builds llms-full.txt,
the full text of the pages outside Optional.

## Start here

- [Cicada quick start for agents](docs/manual/agent-quickstart.md): the page an agent reads first, which `cicada agents` prints
- [Agents and JSON output](docs/manual/agents.md): every `--json` format, its fields and error codes

## Language

- [Writing music](docs/manual/writing-music.md): tracks, patterns, pitches, drum rows, scenes and songs
- [Composing a complete song](docs/manual/composing-songs.md): form, chord voicing, grids and transitions
- [Cicada source edition 2](docs/spec/edition-2.md): what edition 2 of the language adds and changes
- [Language extensions](docs/spec/features.md): every feature of the language, with its rules

## Sound and delivery

- [Exporting](docs/manual/exporting.md): WAV, stems and MIDI
- [Audition](docs/manual/audition.md): the listening report: key, chords, levels, brightness, rhythm
- [Opt-in mix chain](docs/audio/mix-chain.md): track inserts, sends, master effects and loudness targets
- [Parameter ranges](docs/manual/parameter-ranges.md): the allowed range of every voice, drum and effect setting

## Reference

- [Diagnostic codes](docs/manual/diagnostics.md): every diagnostic code with its meaning and fix
- [Troubleshooting](docs/manual/troubleshooting.md): notation, editor, playback and export problems
- [CLI reference](docs/cli.md): every command and flag of the cicada binary
